ActionParam.description:
A field of the action's request that the user's tariff configuration supplies.

The value comes from ``tariff.import.action_params[name]`` (Phase 4 WP4), e.g. the
Nord Pool ``config_entry`` id or ``areas``. SunCore never invents such a value.
ActionParam.title: ActionParam

ActionSeries.description: Series returned by a read-only action (``return_response`` is implied).
ActionSeries.title: ActionSeries

AttributeSeries.description:
Series held in an attribute of the entities of ``roles`` (concatenated in order).

``list_path`` (Phase 4, generic attribute adapter): dotted path from the attribute's
value to the points when the attribute is a mapping (``None`` = the attribute itself
holds the points). ``shape`` says what the points are:

* ``list`` (default): a list of objects named by ``fields`` (Solcast
  ``detailedForecast``);
* ``mapping``: an object ``{iso_timestamp: value}`` (Forecast.Solar ``wh_hours``,
  Open-Meteo Solar Forecast ``wh_period_15m``); ``fields`` then gives only
  ``value_unit`` - no point field names and no quantiles.

The period length of a point is the template's ``resolution_min``.
AttributeSeries.title: AttributeSeries

BatteryModeMeaning.description: What selecting a battery mode option does.
BatteryModeMeaning.title: BatteryModeMeaning

BatteryTemplate.description:
Battery adapter template (Phase 4, ADR-0006/ADR-0012 kind ``battery``).

``roles`` are the readable and writable entities (e.g. ``soc``, ``power``,
``min_soc_number``, ``max_charge_number``, ``max_discharge_number``, ``mode_select``,
``force_charge_switch``); ``controls`` says what each *writable* role expresses. A
role without a control is read only. Writes go through the safety gate only.
BatteryTemplate.title: BatteryTemplate

ChargerControl.description:
An EV charger driven through Home Assistant entities (ADR-0017 decision 1, PR 6-I).

``role`` is the charging current (number entity, A); ``enable_role`` an optional switch;
``phases_role`` an optional select or switch whose option for one and for three phases is
``phase_option_1`` / ``phase_option_3``. ``phases`` is the number of phases the charger is
wired with; ``phase_switching`` needs a ``phases_role`` and a three-phase charger (plan §0
decision 6). ``phase_switch_pause_s`` is the pause around a switch (vendor-dependent,
``UNVERIFIED``), ``max_phase_switches_per_hour`` the wear limit. Written by ``ChargeAction``.
ChargerControl.title: ChargerControl

ContinuousControl.description: A number entity in W, A or % of ``nominal_w`` between ``min`` and ``max``.
ContinuousControl.title: ContinuousControl

CopCurve.description:
COP over outdoor temperature: 2-8 points, piecewise linear, clamped at the ends.

``assumed`` marks a curve that is not from a vendor source (the generic default); the UI
labels it as an assumption.
CopCurve.title: CopCurve

CopPoint.description: The coefficient of performance at one outdoor temperature.
CopPoint.title: CopPoint

DeviceDefaults.description:
Defaults copied into a new :class:`~suncore.core.devices.DeviceConfig`.

Phase 6 (additive): ``ev`` (wallbox), ``program`` (program) and ``thermal`` (thermal kinds,
e.g. a vendor COP curve with the template's ``source``) - the same models as on the device.
DeviceDefaults.title: DeviceDefaults

DeviceKind.description: Kind of controllable device. Templates use climate, switch and number_load for now.
DeviceKind.title: DeviceKind

EnergyDashboardSeries.description:
Series read from the WebSocket command ``energy/solar_forecast`` (Phase 4, forecasts only).

The command returns ``{config_entry_id: {"wh_hours": {iso_timestamp: Wh}}}`` for the forecast
integrations linked in the Energy dashboard (Forecast.Solar in Home Assistant core). The
template names no entity: the user binds the source to a config entry
(``ForecastSourceConfig.config_entry_id``), or SunCore takes the only entry there is.
``fields`` gives only ``value_unit`` (energy per period; no quantiles). The length of a
period is inferred from the spacing of the timestamps; the template's ``resolution_min``
is the expected length (used for a series of one point).
EnergyDashboardSeries.title: EnergyDashboardSeries

EntityMatcher.description:
Role matcher; every given criterion must match, ``domain`` is mandatory.

``units`` lists acceptable ``unit_of_measurement`` strings (exact, case-sensitive);
``unit_pattern`` is a regular expression matched with ``re.fullmatch`` on the stripped
unit. ``translation_key`` / ``translation_key_pattern`` likewise. Exact and pattern
forms exclude each other.
EntityMatcher.title: EntityMatcher

EvSpec.description:
The vehicle behind a charger (kind ``wallbox``; one vehicle per charger in v1).

Roles (all optional, mapped in ``DeviceConfig.entities``): ``vehicle_soc_role`` (sensor %),
``connected_role`` (binary sensor), ``charging_role`` (binary sensor). Without a SoC the
targets are energy-based. ``efficiency`` is the charging efficiency (losses, default 0.9).
EvSpec.title: EvSpec

FeedInTier.description:
Feed-in remuneration band, data only (no legal advice).

Bands apply to the share of the plant up to ``up_to_kwp`` (cumulative, lower bounds
are the previous band); ``None`` = no upper bound and only allowed on the last band.
FeedInTier.title: FeedInTier

ForceChargeSwitchControl.description: A ``switch`` role: on = force charging (from the grid if PV is short), off = auto.
ForceChargeSwitchControl.title: ForceChargeSwitchControl

LearnedThermal.description: A fitted model with its quality (``nrmse`` of a 24 h replay) and history length.
LearnedThermal.title: LearnedThermal

LoadpointControl.description:
An evcc loadpoint driven over evcc's MQTT API (ADR-0017 decision 2, PR 6-J).

No Home Assistant entity is written; ``topic_prefix`` (evcc default ``evcc``) and
``loadpoint_id`` address the loadpoint, ``vehicle`` the evcc vehicle name for plans.
Loadpoint ids start at 1 in the evcc source read on 2026-11-24 (``server/mqtt.go``).
LoadpointControl.title: LoadpointControl

ModbusRegisterMap.description:
Registers of a limit-with-fallback battery interface (Kostal §3.5, ``kostal_modbus``).

Addresses as the vendor document gives them (the HA action writes them verbatim). Powers
are IEEE 754 float32 in two registers, the timeout an unsigned 32-bit value in two
registers; the word order comes from the battery configuration (``battery.modbus``).
``external_control_value`` is what ``external_control_register`` must read before any
write (Kostal 1080 = ``0x02``: external battery management via Modbus).
ModbusRegisterMap.title: ModbusRegisterMap

Mode.description: One mode of a mode-controlled device and the power it draws.
Mode.title: Mode

ModeControl.description: Select one of several modes (select entity or climate preset).
ModeControl.title: ModeControl

ModeSelectControl.description: A ``select`` role choosing the battery's operating mode.
ModeSelectControl.title: ModeSelectControl

NegativePriceRule.description: Feed-in remuneration during negative spot prices.
NegativePriceRule.title: NegativePriceRule

NotifyControl.description:
A program that SunCore never switches (PR 6-L, plan §8 6-B question "notify-only").

The user is asked to start the appliance by a notification; SunCore writes nothing and
detects the start by the appliance's power. Valid only for kind ``program`` with
``program.start_method: notify``.
NotifyControl.title: NotifyControl

NumberLimitControl.description:
A ``number`` role that sets a battery limit.

``min_soc``: discharge floor in ``%`` (discharge lock / reserve); ``max_charge`` and
``max_discharge``: power limits; ``grid_charge_power``: forced charging power from the
grid. ``min``/``max``/``step`` are the entity's range in ``unit`` (``%`` of the
battery's maximum power for the power kinds).
NumberLimitControl.title: NumberLimitControl

PowerModelDefault.description:
Default power model; ``power_role``/``energy_role`` refer to roles of the template.

``nominal_w`` is only a hint: a template cannot know the user's model, the wizard asks
(the instance-level :class:`~suncore.core.devices.PowerModel` stays strict).
PowerModelDefault.title: PowerModelDefault

PowerModelKind.description: How a device's power is obtained (BRIEF §4.5); each kind yields an uncertain estimate.
PowerModelKind.title: PowerModelKind

ProgramSpec.description:
A shiftable program (kind ``program``; ADR-0017 decision 7).

``profile_wh`` is the energy per 15 minutes of a run (``None`` = nominal power x run time);
its length must cover ``runtime_min``. ``start_method``: ``plug`` (a smart plug switched on;
needs ``resume_confirmed``, the user's statement that the appliance resumes after power
returns - ``UNVERIFIED`` per appliance), ``remote`` (a ``button``/``switch`` role) or
``notify`` (the user is asked to start it). ``idle_w`` is the "finished" threshold.

PR 6-L: the ``resume_confirmed`` rule is checked on the device (``DeviceConfig``), not here,
so a template can default to ``plug`` while the user still has to confirm on the device.
ProgramSpec.title: ProgramSpec

RelayStep.description: One level of a relay-switched load: the relays that are on and the power it draws.
RelayStep.title: RelayStep

RelaysControl.description:
Discrete power levels made of 1-3 switch entities (e.g. a heater with three elements).

``roles`` are the relay switches; step ``i`` means exactly the relays listed in
``steps[i].relays`` are on and the others are off. Step 0 is the lowest level
(normally all off). Added to schema v1 as an additive union member (ADR-0012).
RelaysControl.title: RelaysControl

RoleSpec.description: One entity role of a template.
RoleSpec.title: RoleSpec

SeriesFields.description:
Names of the fields of one series point and the unit of its values.

``timestamp_field`` and ``value_field`` are required for a list of point objects
(``action`` series, ``attribute`` series of shape ``list``) and absent for an
``attribute`` series of shape ``mapping``, whose keys are the timestamps and whose
values are the values.
SeriesFields.title: SeriesFields

SetpointControl.description: Shift the user's temperature set-point inside the comfort band (needs ``comfort``).
SetpointControl.title: SetpointControl

SgContacts.description: The two SG-Ready contacts of one state (``True`` = closed / switch on).
SgContacts.title: SgContacts

SgReadyControl.description:
SG-Ready heat pump interface: two contact switches (ADR-0017 decision 5, PR 6-K).

Written with ``StepAction``: step 0 = SG state 2 (normal, the baseline and release),
1 = state 3 (intensified), 2 = state 4 (forced on, only with ``allow_forced``). **State 1
(utility block) has no step and is never written.** Which contact pair selects which state
is vendor-specific: the template states it with a ``source`` (``UNVERIFIED`` otherwise).
SgReadyControl.title: SgReadyControl

SourceRef.description: Documentation a template (or one of its facts) is based on.
SourceRef.title: SourceRef

Step.description: One level of a stepped load: the value written and the power it draws.
Step.title: Step

StepsControl.description: Discrete power levels written to ``role`` (select option or number).
StepsControl.title: StepsControl

TestedWith.description: Integration version the template was verified against.
TestedWith.title: TestedWith

ThermalModel.description: First-order RC parameters of a thermal store.
ThermalModel.title: ThermalModel

ThermalSpec.description:
Heat-pump and thermal-store options (ADR-0017 decision 6; kinds with a comfort band).

``cop`` ``None`` = the generic air/water assumption (``core.thermal``); ``learned`` is the
fitted RC model (written by the learner, PR 6-K). ``grid_preheat`` allows pre-heating
with cheap grid energy (default off, plan §0 decision 8); the lift band is the device's
comfort band.
ThermalSpec.title: ThermalSpec
